Filtered Relevant Items:
1. [6] Node-status and health-check queries can time out during a network partition; recording explicit timeout results preserves partial status instead of dropping the affected node status entirely.

External Knowledge Summary:
- The only closely relevant discussion indicates that repeated unavailable node statuses may result from timed-out status checks during network disruption.
- Timed-out checks should be recorded explicitly so nodes appear degraded or offline rather than having their status omitted.
- No retrieved item directly explains the “configured out” status.
